title: 第57章 你的遗言，我知道！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 两日后。天刚亮，唐逸便带着杜凌菲和唐音出城给母亲扫墓。今日，是母亲的忌日。过去两年，前身和唐音都被禁足，无论是清明还是逢年过节，颜霜玉都不准前身和唐音给母亲扫墓。理由都如出一辙，嫌晦气。儿子给母亲扫墓，这种天经地义的事情，在她眼中竟然如此不堪。唐逸有些后悔，今日出门的时候，应该“请示”一下颜霜玉的。要是她敢说晦气两个字，他会当场将颜霜玉供在家中的父母牌位劈了当柴烧！老子祭拜母亲你嫌晦气，你天天上香不晦气了？母亲的墓在北城外，原本唐逸以为两年没有人给母亲扫墓，母亲的墓肯定会杂草丛生。但是抵达之后，他才发现母亲的墓很干净，显然有人定期过来扫墓。唐家的人薄情寡义，绝对不可能这么做的，那么给母亲扫墓的，应该是外婆或者是舅舅。而如今，舅舅还官司缠身，如今身陷囹圄，他不能不管。而要查这件事，恐怕还得找萧策帮帮忙。想到这里唐逸顿时有些惆怅，宫里那老皇帝不道德啊！帮你出谋划策，说好的奖励呢？这都过去两天了，毛都没见到。“娘，过去两年没能来给你扫墓，是我的错，以后我和音儿会定期来看你。”“你放心，我会招呼好妹妹的，有我在，以后谁敢欺负她，我必定会让其付出千倍万倍的代价。”“娘，对不起，我以后要走自己的路了。”“这条路和你所期望的不同，我要和这个世界争一争，看一下能不能让这个世道稍微变得好一点。”唐逸带着唐音给母亲上了香，磕了头。以前，母亲最大的期望，就是他和妹妹能健康幸福生活下去。至于风暴，有父亲和母亲在前面扛着。可最后，扛下所有风暴的只有母亲而已。唐敬的肩膀，一直都为颜霜玉母子而留，他和妹妹在唐敬眼中，不过是权利交织下的产物罢了。“哥哥，娘在这里会不会很孤单。”唐音看向唐逸，眼睛一眨，眼泪大颗大颗从眼角滑落。她都快忘记母亲的模样了。“回去之后，咱们重新给母亲立个牌位吧，立一个好牌位。”唐逸揉了揉妹妹的脑袋，唐家不认母亲，不让母亲进祠堂，没关系，他和妹妹认就可以了。“凌菲，你照顾一下我妹妹，我去办点事。”回到山下，唐逸将唐音交给杜凌菲，一个人重新爬上了另一座最高的山。那座山山顶，立着一座没有立碑的土坟。唐逸走到坟边站了好一会儿，叹了口气，取出酒壶在坟前倒了半壶酒。随即，唐逸坐在坟旁，也静静看着北方。许久，唐逸往自己嘴里灌了一口酒，道：“某种意义上来说，你应该是我来到这个世界间接杀的第一个人。”“但如果重来一次的话，我依旧会选择揭穿你。”“北境十六州沦陷，几十万人成为北狄的奴隶，十几年了，大炎对北境十六州的归属，连个屁都不敢放，你们恨，应该。”“你们想要大炎覆灭，应该。”“只是你选择的方式不对，你可以自己组建势力，自己把军队拉起来，然后杀到京都，将那些不作为的王八蛋干死！”“那样，就算你失败了，我依旧会说一声牛逼。”“可是，你不该选择这种方式，这样会害死无数无辜的人。”“当然，这只是我自己的立场……毕竟有些理，是没办法讲的。”唐逸喃喃自语。他已经从宁川那里知道了一切，知道这个男人在大殿上怒斥满朝文武，怒斥皇帝，最后向北自尽。甚至自尽的时候，因为咬断了舌头，没有人知道他最后的遗言说了什么。只知道当时的他，血溅三尺！“我知道你想说什么，或许……只有我知道。”唐逸站了起来，将酒壶中的酒全倒在坟前。前世，作为军人，还差一个地方，没有收复。而坟中男人的愿望，无非就是想要北境十六州回归罢了。嘟！这时，号角声忽然传荡整个山谷。唐逸转身看去，只见山下蜿蜒的道路上，正有一支军队浩浩荡荡向北开进。战马嘶鸣，战旗激荡，宛若一条火色长龙一般向北席卷而去。那是援助北境的大军，终于开拔了！唐逸有些羡慕，当年霍去病马上封侯的时候，应该也就他现在这般年纪吧？……又过了一天。唐逸终于等到了他想要等的人。宫里的传旨太监。宫里那个老皇帝，总算想起了他这个功臣了。“奉天承运皇帝，诏曰：户部侍郎之子唐逸，聪明伶俐，智慧过人，擢升为锦衣卫百户，立即到锦衣卫入职……”唐逸听着小太监宣读圣旨，总算是松了一口气。还好，和预想的出入不是很大。锦衣卫，天子直属，号称天子剑。上可审公卿王侯，下可斩贪官污吏，虽然名声早就被那些文官弄得臭不可闻，但权势滔天。刚好可以借助这个身份，查一下舅舅的案子。花了一百两送走了传旨太监，唐逸便返回房间，换上了飞鱼服和绣春刀。虽然他身体还没有补回来，还是有点虚，但他穿着飞鱼服和绣春刀出来的时候，还是把院中的杜凌菲和唐音惊到了。飞鱼服穿在他的身上，穿出了一股英武的气质！“呀，大哥好漂亮。”唐音瞪着一双大眼睛，他还第一次见到哥哥这么好看呢。现在的哥哥出去，肯定能迷倒京都一大群小娘。唐逸抬手敲了敲女孩的脑门，没好气道：“漂亮是用来形容女孩子的，对你哥，你应该说好帅，太帅了，酷毙了！”杜凌菲走了过来，绕着唐逸转了一圈，也是啧啧称奇。“不错，这身衣服感觉就是为你量身定制的。”“穿在你身上，总感觉有一种很独特的气质……嗯，怎么说呢？感觉很正气。”“说句实话，我觉得这才是锦衣卫该有的样子。”就是不知道这样才华横溢的大才子，闻名京都的小诗仙进入锦衣卫，将来他的身份暴露了，又有多少文人要骂娘了。嘻嘻，想到那个画面就很令人期待呀。杜凌菲嘴角勾起，忍不住畅想起来。
content_en: Two days later.At dawn, Tang Yi took Du Lingfei and Tang Yin out of the city to visit his mother's grave.Today is my mother’s death anniversary.In the past two years, Yan Shuangyu and Tang Yin were both banned from visiting their mother's grave, whether during the Qingming Festival or during the New Year.The reasons are all the same, they are unlucky.A son visiting his mother's grave, something that was only natural and natural, was so disgusting in her eyes.Tang Yi regretted a little. When he went out today, he should "ask for instructions" from Yan Shuangyu.If she dared to say the word "bad luck", he would chop up the memorial tablet of Yan Shuangyu's parents at home and burn it on the spot!You think it's bad luck for me to worship my mother. Isn't it bad luck for you to offer incense every day?His mother's tomb is outside Beicheng. Tang Yi originally thought that if no one visited his mother's tomb in two years, his mother's tomb would definitely be overgrown with weeds.But after arriving, he discovered that his mother's tomb was very clean, and someone apparently came to visit it regularly.People in the Tang family are unsympathetic and unjust, so it is absolutely impossible for them to do this, so the person who sweeps mother's grave should be grandma or uncle.But now, his uncle is still involved in a lawsuit and is now in jail, so he can't ignore it.And to investigate this matter, I'm afraid I have to ask Xiao Ce for help.Thinking of this, Tang Yi suddenly felt melancholy. The old emperor in the palace was immoral!I'll help you make suggestions. Where's the promised reward?Two days have passed and Mao has not been seen."Mom, it's my fault that I haven't been able to visit your grave in the past two years. From now on, Yin'er and I will visit you regularly." "Don't worry, I will take good care of my sister. As long as I am here, whoever dares to bully her in the future will definitely make them pay a thousand times the price.""Mom, I'm sorry, I have to go my own way in the future.""This path is different from what you expected. I want to fight with the world to see if I can make the world a little better."Tang Yi took Tang Yin to offer incense to his mother and kowtowed.In the past, his mother's greatest hope was that he and his sister could live a healthy and happy life.As for the storm, my father and mother were carrying it in front.But in the end, it was only the mother who bore all the storms.Tang Jing's shoulders have always been reserved for Yan Shuangyu's mother and son. In Tang Jing's eyes, he and his sister are just products of the intertwined power."Brother, will my mother be lonely here?" Tang Yin looked at Tang Yi, blinking, and tears fell from the corners of his eyes.She had almost forgotten what her mother looked like."After we go back, let's set up a new memorial tablet for our mother, a good one." Tang Yi rubbed his sister's head. The Tang family didn't recognize his mother and wouldn't let her enter the ancestral hall. It didn't matter. He and his sister could recognize her."Ling Fei, take care of my sister, I'll go do something." Back at the bottom of the mountain, Tang Yi handed Tang Yin to Du Lingfei, and climbed up another highest mountain alone.At the top of that mountain, there was an earthen tomb without a monument.Tang Yi walked to the grave and stood for a long time, sighed, took out the wine bottle and poured half a bottle of wine in front of the grave.Immediately, Tang Yi sat beside the grave and looked north quietly.After a long time, Tang Yi poured a sip of wine into his mouth and said: "In a sense, you should be the first person I indirectly killed when I came to this world." "But if I had to do it over again, I would still choose to expose you." "The Sixteen Northern States fell, and hundreds of thousands of people became Beidi's slaves. For more than ten years, Dayan did not even dare to let go of his ownership of the Sixteen Northern States. You hate it, so you should." "You want Great Yan to be destroyed, so you should."It's just that the method you chose is wrong. You can form your own forces, pull up the army, and kill those bastards who don't do anything!""That way, even if you fail, I will still say you are awesome.""But you shouldn't choose this method, which will kill countless innocent people.""Of course, this is just my own position... After all, there is no way to explain it."He already knew everything from Ning Chuan. He knew that this man angrily denounced the civil and military officials of the court and the emperor in the main hall, and finally committed suicide northward.Even when he committed suicide, no one knew what his last words were because he bit off his tongue.All I know is that he was covered in blood!"I know what you want to say, maybe... only I know." Tang Yi stood up and poured all the wine in the jug in front of the grave.In the previous life, as a soldier, there was still a place to be recovered.The wish of the man in the grave is nothing more than the return of the sixteen northern states.beep!At this time, the sound of the horn suddenly spread throughout the valley.Tang Yi turned around and saw an army marching northward on the winding road at the foot of the mountain.The war horses neighed and the battle flags wavered, sweeping northward like a long fiery dragon.That is the army to aid the northern border, and it has finally set off!Tang Yi was a little envious. When Huo Qubing was about to be granted the title of Marquis, he would have been around his current age, right?...Another day has passed.Tang Yi finally waited for the person he wanted to wait for.The eunuch who delivers orders in the palace.The old emperor in the palace finally remembered him as a hero."The emperor is destined to be blessed by heaven, and the edict says: Tang Yi, the son of the minister of household affairs, is smart and intelligent. He will be promoted to Jinyiwei Baihu, and he will immediately join the Jinyiwei..." Tang Yi finally breathed a sigh of relief as he listened to the eunuch reading out the imperial edict.Fortunately, it is not much different from what was expected.Jinyiwei, directly under the emperor, is known as the Emperor's Sword.At the top, he can judge princes and princes, and at the bottom, he can kill corrupt officials. Although his reputation has long been ruined by those civil servants, his power is overwhelming.I can just use this identity to investigate my uncle's case.After spending a hundred taels to send off the eunuch who delivered the order, Tang Yi returned to the room and changed into Feiyu clothes and embroidered spring knife.Although his body had not recovered and was still a little weak, when he came out wearing Feiyu suit and embroidered spring knife, he still surprised Du Lingfei and Tang Yin in the courtyard.When he wore the Feiyu suit, he exuded a heroic aura!"Ah, brother is so beautiful." Tang Yin stared with big eyes. This was the first time he had seen his brother look so good-looking.When my brother goes out now, he will definitely be able to charm a lot of girls in Kyoto.Tang Yi raised his hand and knocked on the girl's forehead, and said angrily: "Beautiful is used to describe girls. To your brother, you should say so handsome, so handsome, so cool!" Du Lingfei came over, circled around Tang Yi, and was also amazed."Yes, this outfit feels like it was tailor-made for you." "When I wear it on you, I always feel that I have a very unique temperament... Well, how should I put it? It feels very upright." "To be honest, I think this is what Jin Yiwei should look like.
title_en: Chapter 57 I know your last words!
